title: cyclosorus pilososquamatus
intro: Cyclosorus pilososquamatus, commonly known as the hairy shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Cyclosorus pilososquamatus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress.
